document: Trackmania 2020 official vehicle behavior changelog — measurements manifest

status_vocabulary.measured: produced by executing the game/dedicated server, or read out of shipped bytes with a decoder
status_vocabulary.derived: exact arithmetic on measured values, or direct reading of instruction semantics
status_vocabulary.officially_described: stated by Nadeo; recorded only alongside an observed code/data delta, never as a magnitude

magnitude_channel.what: the only channel in the instrument that yields a magnitude rather than a verdict
magnitude_channel.how: a run that COMPLETES on both builds and returns a different lap time; the server prints both numbers in its Desc, e.g. 'race finished, time is worse. (25470 < 26958)'
excluded_from_magnitudes: using known-flawed game exe — validation policy, the run was never simulated
wrong simu with no finish — real disagreement, but yields no number

measurements.boundary_note: no archived server exists between these dates
measurements.quantity: lap time of recorded runs re-simulated from identical inputs
measurements.official_note: none — the 2020-09-11 changelog covers netcode, UI, clubs, editors; no driving statement

measurements.quantity: lap time of recorded runs re-simulated from identical inputs
measurements.globality_evidence: changed runs include recordings up to eleven months older than the update, on maps containing none of its new elements; the change is not confined to one surface or feature

code_vs_data.detail: dedicated_TMStadium.pak (2c4464fe95be), dedicated.pak (bac0b0d82978) and the title pack (6a59f546e735) are byte-identical across the boundary; only the executable differs

measurements.official_note: 2021-06-12 Royal post says the mode 'comes with new physics'; the measured boundary is 2021-06-08, four days earlier. Consistent with, not evidence for.

measurements.quantity: completability and finish time of a fixed tape on an ice map
measurements.before_semantics: no valid finish; WRONG_SIMU, validated time -1

measurements.derived_part: extent deltas; axis labelling assumes Y-up

adjacent_boundary_sweep_2020_2022.method: for every adjacent pair of the 43 dated server builds, count runs completing on both and how many return a different lap time
adjacent_boundary_sweep_2020_2022.note: boundaries changing 0-4 runs are reported but NOT published as behavior rows; the negative controls below set that floor

boundaries_with_changed_runs.official_note: Fall 2021 update; magnitude below control support

negative_controls.claim_tested: campaign content alone can change lap times
negative_controls.detail: builds 2020-10-02/10-12/11-04/11-16 share one executable and byte-identical physics packs, differing only in the title pack; across all three adjacent pairs 203-204 runs complete and 0 change time

negative_controls.claim_tested: an executable hash change implies a behavior change
negative_controls.detail: 2021-01-18->01-20 and 2021-02-03->02-08 each change the executable with packs identical; both 123 complete, 0 changed. 39 distinct server executables are not 39 epochs.

policy_vs_physics.meaning: the server refuses to validate a run because its RECORDING client build is blacklisted; the run is never simulated
policy_vs_physics.presence: absent from all six July 2020 server executables, present from 2020-09-11 onward
policy_vs_physics.consequence: counting these as physics flips would manufacture an epoch out of a validation-policy change; they are excluded from every magnitude

reference_run_current_build.input: full throttle, no steering, 22.000 s keyhold, 431 keydown batches

discrimination_floor.quantity: finish_plane_speed spread across three patched variants

open_discrepancy.resolution: RR-01, to be reconciled against the newly banked exact Sep-30 trace

epochs_without_behavior_rows.reason: four boundaries measured, max 2 changed runs at 0.009 s; launch builds core-dump on later probes
seven boundaries, 0-4 changed runs each, including the officially described Fall 2021 step
no full client in the public archive
causal split not localised; no oracle after 2022-06-21
route change does not establish the announced semantics
path-string delta only; physics blob bit-identical
no officially described change; hash churn is not evidence

never_measured_quantities: collision geometry for Stadium, Rally, Desert
which force law changed at S-0 or S-1 (lap time is an aggregate)
